jobs.title: Hardware Test Engineering Co-Op at Delta Faucet Company
jobs.description: Employer: Delta Faucet Company - Delta Faucet HQ- Indianapolis, IN Expires: 10/23/2026 At Delta Faucet, we are committed to transforming everyday experiences with water through innovative products and exceptional service. As a leader in the plumbing industry, we take pride in our dedication to quality, sustainability, and customer satisfaction. We believe that diverse perspectives strengthen our mission to create solutions that inspire and elevate the lives of all our customers. We welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us on this journey toward inclusivity and excellence. Your Role at Delta FaucetDelta Faucet Company has an opportunity for a Hardware Engineering Co-op to join our Connected Water Team to help deliver the next generation of product features and technology to our customers. In this role, you will support the development of new digital products through hands-on work with embedded systems and real product hardware. You will spend most of your days in the lab doing hands-on and varied tasks: soldering and reworking assemblies, programming and bringing up circuit boards, running electrical and functional tests, laying out PCBs, and keeping our engineering lab and its equipment running as smoothly as possible.You will report to the engineering manager and sit with the project teams, not apart from them. Within your first few weeks you will be assigned specific tasks, projects, and test processes to own — meaning you make the calls there, you document how it works, and you are the person others ask about it. When you find a better way to do something, we want to hear it, and we will give you a straight answer either way. Every part of the role is scoped so that the skills you leave with — test methodology, debugging discipline, documentation, lab ownership — are the ones that help you with the rest of your college work and prepare you for your future career. Responsibilities:Build and ReworkSolder, rework, and modify through-hole and surface-mount assemblies for prototypes, test fixtures, and engineering samples.Assemble and wire test fixtures, harnesses, and benchtop setups from schematics and written instructions.Program, flash, and bring up circuit boards; verify power rails, signal integrity, and basic functionality on new builds.Test and DebugExecute electrical, functional, and reliability tests on products and subassemblies, and record results accurately.Investigate test failures: reproduce the issue, isolate it to a component or subsystem, and document what you found so an engineer can act on it.Write and maintain basic test scripts and data-logging routines to automate repetitive measurements.Operate and troubleshoot standard bench equipment — oscilloscopes, DMMs, power supplies, function generators, data acquisition systems, environmental chambers.Design SupportProduce PCB layouts for test fixtures, adapter boards, and design revisions under engineering guidance.Review schematics and layouts for manufacturability and testability, and raise concerns before boards are ordered.Suggest product and process improvements based on what you observe on the benchLab and Calibration OwnershipOrganize and manage the engineering lab: equipment inventory, tool and fixture storage, consumable stock, workspace layout, and bench readiness.Run the equipment calibration program — track calibration due dates, coordinate with vendors, maintain certificates, and keep instruments in a known-good state.Establish and document standard operating procedures for test setups, lab safety, and equipment use so results are repeatable across people and across time.Maintain clear technical documentation: test reports, procedures, wiring diagrams, bring-up notes, and change records.Where this goesWe treat this co-op as the first step in a career here, not a temporary set of hands. The scope is designed to grow with you:In your first term, you will learn our products, our lab, and our test methods, supporting engineers on defined tasks.As you demonstrate judgment, you will take ownership of specific test areas, fixtures, and the calibration program — work that is yours, with your name on it.Strong co-ops are invited back for additional terms with expanded responsibility, and we actively look to convert high performers into full-time engineering or test roles at graduation.You will finish with a portfolio of real work: products you helped validate, fixtures you designed, procedures you wrote, and failures you tracked down. That is experience that transfers anywhere — and we would rather you build it here and stay. QualificationsCurrently pursuing a Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical engineering, Electrical Engineering Technology, or related fieldDemonstrated hands-on experience — coursework labs, senior design, competition teams (IEEE, Robotics, etc.), maker projects, or personal builds. Show us what you have made.Excellent soldering experience, including small components and SMT reworkFoundational understanding of analog and digital circuits. Comfort reading schematics and interpreting datasheets and basic specifications.Careful, methodical work habits. In test engineering, sloppy data is worse than no data, and this role is built on trustworthy measurements.Clear written communication — you will write procedures and failure reports that other people rely on.Familiarity with microcontrollers, embedded systems, and electronics lab equipmentStrong problem-solving skills, curiosity, and a willingness to learn in a hands-on engineering environmentInterest in IoT, connected products, or consumer electronics is a plus The target compensation for the role is $22.00 hour. Why Join Us?At Delta Faucet Company, our people are our greatest assets. We value different perspectives and fostering an inclusive environment. You’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of our brand, working alongside passionate professionals committed to excellence and innovation. Join us to lead progressive growth and make a significant impact within a leading organization.Here are some of the benefits we offer for your personal and professional growth:Culture: Recognized and award-winning reputation for equality, diversity and inclusion, flexibility, work-life balance, and more.Wellbeing: Comprehensive benefit plans; retirement, savings, tuition reimbursement, and employee incentive programs; resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.Learning & Development: LinkedIn Learning access; internal opportunities to work on projects cross-company.Social Impact: Four employee-led and self-directed Business Resource Groups; Paid volunteer day annually; Employees share their time, skills and talent with charities and nonprofit organizations across the U.S. and around the globe. Company: Delta Faucet Company Part time Delta Faucet Company (the “Company”) is an equal opportunity employer and we strive to employ the most qualified individuals for every position. The Company makes employment decisions only based on merit. It is the Company’s policy to prohibit discrimination in any employment opportunity (including but not limited to recruitment, employment, promotion, salary increases, benefits, termination and all other terms and conditions of employment) based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, pregnancy, religious creed, national origin, ancestry, age, physical/mental disability, medical condition, marital/domestic partner status, military and veteran status, height, weight or any other such characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. The Company is committed to complying with all applicable laws providing equal employment opportunities. This commitment applies to all people involved in the operations of the Company regardless of where the employee is located and prohibits unlawful discrimination by any employee of the Company. Delta Faucet Company is an E-Verify employer. jobs.title: 2027 Corporate Technology Summer Internship – New York and Jersey City at Jefferies, LLC
jobs.description: Employer: Jefferies, LLC Expires: 10/23/2026 About JefferiesJefferies is a leading global, full-service investment banking and capital markets firm that provides advisory, sales and trading, research, and wealth and asset management services. With more than 40 offices around the world, we offer insights and expertise to investors, companies, and governments.What you can expectJefferies Summer Interns have the unique opportunity to gain insight into a global, client-focused investment bank and experience an entrepreneurial environment where employees have the opportunity to make an immediate impact and are rewarded for performance. You’ll be exposed to Jefferies’ full range of products and leading industry expertise. Our lean team structure will not only provide you with unparalleled hands-on experience, it will help you develop lasting personal and professional relationships with peers and senior professionals that will serve as the foundation for a successful career.Following an enriching orientation program, Interns will begin working on their day-to-day responsibilities, with support from colleagues serving as both instructors and mentors throughout the internship program. As a way to help maximize your experience with us, Interns will receive formal performance reviews.In addition to working on projects that incorporate research, analysis and recommendations, Interns are challenged to think creatively, offer their input, and add value to the team from day one. As with everyone at Jefferies, Interns are expected to pursue their projects with excellence, a collaborative spirit, and with the highest levels of integrity.What we look for in a candidateWe look for candidates who are eager to make an impact for our clients by doing real, hands-on work. Successful Jefferies Interns are able to multitask and manage a variety of projects simultaneously. Candidates must demonstrate professionalism and relationship management skills together with strong technical, written, and verbal communication skills. The work is fast paced, challenging, and intellectually stimulating. The ability to work under pressure and tight deadlines, be adaptable, and work both independently and as part of a team are essential traits of a successful candidate. Candidates should have a strong academic background and be pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree or equivalent program.Desired Background and SkillsCandidates pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Security, Cybersecurity, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical fieldExpected graduation between December 2027 and June 2028Programming or scripting experience in one or more of Python, Java, C#, JavaScript, SQL, Bash, PowerShell or VBAInterest in platform reliability, site reliability engineering, information security, cloud, infrastructure, enterprise applications or automationExposure to Linux, Unix or Windows; databases; networking; virtualization; containers; Kubernetes; or cloud platforms such as AWS and AzureFamiliarity with observability and DevOps practices, including Git, CI/CD, Prometheus, Grafana or related toolsExperience with APIs, data analysis, BI/reporting, workflow automation, Power Platform, UiPath or AI/ML is a plusStrong analytical, problem-solving, written and verbal communication skillsAbility to learn quickly, collaborate in a fast-paced global team and focus on reliability, security, operational excellence and disciplined deliveryWORK WITH US - Opportunities in Information TechnologyThe Jefferies Technology team is increasingly a source of revenue and competitive advantage for one of the fastest growing investment banking firms in the world. Our business technologists enable Jefferies’ sales, trading, research and banking colleagues to solve problems and seize opportunities with more speed and precision than ever before. We deploy and manage the technology that keeps Jefferies running and our colleagues connected. We develop applications and tools to serve Jefferies’ clients and enhance business outcomes with AI and machine learning tools. In an industry being radically reshaped by technology, our IT team is integrated into every facet of Jefferies’ business.An Opportunity to Explore: At Jefferies, you can go where your talents and interests take you. We want curious and creative people eager to push the boundaries of what they can do and passionate about using technology to solve problems and deliver better outcomes for our business.A No Corner Office Culture: Our business technologists work alongside the colleagues they support. This proximity helps technologists understand how the business operates, which data matters, and how to build platforms and applications that create practical value.A Chance to Unlock the Power of Big Data: Our technologists are helping advance cloud computing, native applications, AI and machine learning to translate data into actionable insights, automate functions, strengthen security and make client service more seamless.A Team of Builders and Problem Solvers: Jefferies is growing, entering new markets and regions, and often building technology platforms from the ground up. Technology is central to answering mission-critical questions and delivering the right solution at the right moment.Summer Analyst and Associate Interns may be placed in one of the following teams: Platform Reliability Engineering and Management (PREM), CISO / Information Security, Infrastructure, or Corporate Technology.PLATFORM RELIABILITY ENGINEERING AND MANAGEMENT (PREM)PREM is responsible for the stability and resiliency of Jefferies’ front-to-back platforms and contributes to service reliability, system resiliency and firm-wide risk mitigation. The team applies Site Reliability Engineering principles across engineering and support, with a focus on automation, toil reduction, capacity management, operational excellence and platform health visibility through enterprise observability. Interns may work across distributed and cloud technologies and gain exposure to application and production support, quality engineering and SRE practices.CISO / INFORMATION SECURITYThe Global Information Security organization protects Jefferies critical systems and sensitive information from internal and external cyber attacks through use of technology as well as efforts such as Cyber Data Analytics. The team develops and maintains security controls, monitoring capabilities, and cyber defense platforms that help safeguard the Firm's technology environment while supporting regulatory and compliance requirements. Information Security professionals work across a broad range of disciplines including cyber engineering, threat detection and response, security operations, identity and access management, vulnerability management, cloud security, data protection, and cyber analytics.INFRASTRUCTUREGlobal Infrastructure builds, operates and maintains the technology backbone that enables Jefferies to function efficiently, securely and reliably. Key areas include networking, telecom and multimedia engineering; desktop, virtualization, messaging, Workplace AI and automation; cloud solutions and platforms; database, Unix, Windows Server and systems engineering; and data centers. The organization also advances cloud adoption, automation, workplace technology and network resiliency. Internship opportunities may include cognitive automation cloud engineering and server automation engineering.CORPORATE TECHNOLOGYCorporate Technology delivers platforms and solutions that support Jefferies’ global operations, including post-trade processing and settlement, enterprise data, compliance and legal technology, regulatory reporting, client onboarding, digitalization and automation, and Finance and HR technology. Interns may work on live projects involving software engineering, data and reporting, cloud platforms, workflow automation, API integrations, and AI/ML while collaborating with engineers, analysts and business partners across the Firm.Equal Employment OpportunityAt Jefferies, we are committed to building a culture that provides opportunities for all employees regardless of our differences and supports a workforce that is reflective of the communities where we work and live. As a result, we are able to pool our collective insights and intelligence to provide fresh and innovative thinking for our clients.Jefferies is committed to creating and sustaining a workforce that welcomes individuals from all backgrounds to apply. Our employment decisions are made without regard to race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, pregnancy, age, medical condition, physical or mental disability, marital status, domestic partner status, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, genetic information, reproductive health decisions, or any other factor protected by applicable law. We are committed to hiring the most qualified applicants and complying with all federal, state, and local equal employment opportunity laws. As part of this commitment, Jefferies will extend reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities, as required by applicable law.The salary for the Analyst role is $100,000 and Associate role is $120,000 (pro-rated for the 10-week internship program).

Home to the Monticello/UVA UNESCO world cultural heritage site (one of only ten in the U.S.), the area has a deep and unique architectural heritage. The home of presidents Thomas Jefferson and James Monroe, the area is steeped in history. Charlottesville is dedicated to creating a more sustainable future with a focus on local businesses, farmers markets, and creating walkable and bikeable spaces. With an extensive list of parks, trails, cycling routes, restaurants, wineries, breweries, and other outdoor activities, the Charlottesville area provides unending opportunities for adventure.Office Location – Manassas: Whether you’re interested in urban living or the countryside, Northern Virginia is perfect for the life you want! Our Headquarters is 35 miles from Washington DC / Alexandria / Arlington and 45 miles from Skyline Drive / Shenandoah Valley. The area boasts the diversity of cities, open fields, mountains, rivers, and lakes. We experience a range of seasons from snowy winters to colorful blooms in spring, hot sunny summers, and vibrant autumn leaves. jobs.description: Employer: Ameritas Life Insurance Corp Expires: 10/23/2026 Ameritas is seeking a User Experience (UX) Intern to enhance our customers’ digital experiences by researching user experience across our digital platforms. Translate complex challenges into clear, user-centered solutions. Conduct and analyze UX research to uncover insights and inform design decisions. Create prototypes and design deliverables that effectively communicate ideas to stakeholders. Collaborate with product owners, developers, and designers to ensure a seamless process from concept to launch. Partner with UI developers to align design intent with implementation. Support ongoing product iteration based on research, user feedback, and performance data. Contribute to design system consistency, accessibility standards, and current UX best practices. Participate in project meetings and advocate for the user perspective in cross-functional discussions. Explore ways to integrate AI tools into the design process (e.g., generating design variations, analyzing feedback, enhancing accessibility). Stay curious about emerging technologies, including AI, and how they can elevate the design process and user experience. What You Bring: Must be enrolled in a Master’s degree program at least half-time as defined by your institution studying Human-Computer Interaction, Design, or a related field for the entire duration of the internship. Familiarity with design tools such as Figma and Adobe Creative Suite. Basic understanding of front-end development (HTML, CSS); exposure to AI-assisted design techniques is a plus. Strong attention to detail and ability to translate requirements into interactive solutions. Clear communicator who collaborates well across teams. Awareness of accessibility guidelines, design systems, and web standards. Interest in applying AI tools and data-driven insights to improve design outcomes. Experience with generative AI tools and workflows is a strong advantage. Possess a growth mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, open to feedback, and eager to learn. Being a mutual-based organization, the return on our investment goes back into the company, to benefit our members/customers. jobs.description: Employer: Dancephreakz Expires: 10/23/2026 Phrkz Network | DancePhreakzLocation: Los Angeles County, CA | HybridPosition Type: Part-Time InternshipSchedule: Approximately 8–15 hours per weekCompensation: Paid InternshipAbout the Organization:DancePhreakz is a dynamic, women-owned, and BIPOC-led dance and entertainment production company that is revolutionizing the industry. We bring creativity, energy, and authenticity to the world of dance and movement. Through our four divisions—Production, Apparel, Academy, and our newly acquired studio and event space—we aim to build a platform where BIPOC movement artists thrive, fostering a community that is unapologetically fierce, creative, and ready to make an impact.About Phrkz NetworkPhrkz Network is a new media and entertainment division of DancePhreakz launching in 2026. The Network is an evolution of DancePhreakz's production work into a dedicated home for original shows, podcasts, interviews, digital series, visual projects, documentaries, and culture-driven entertainment.As we build the Network, we're looking for emerging editors who want hands-on experience helping shape the look, pace, and storytelling style of an original digital entertainment platform.About the InternshipWe're seeking two Video Editor & Post-Production Interns to join our growing production team.This is an editing-first position for creatives who already have hands-on editing experience and want to strengthen their portfolio while working on real entertainment programming.You'll edit both long-form and short-form content, including full-length video podcasts, original shows, multi-camera productions, interviews, trailers, teasers, YouTube content, Reels, TikToks, and YouTube Shorts.We want editors who understand that great editing isn't simply cutting footage together. It's about finding the story, creating a hook, controlling pacing, capturing personality, and making viewers want to keep watching.Our creative inspiration comes from modern digital entertainment and culture-driven media platforms such as Hoorae Media, Keytv, Complex, The Black Effect, SpringHill, REVOLT, Joe Budden Podcast, and similar creator-led networks. We're looking for editors interested in understanding what makes their content feel current, entertaining, polished, and highly shareable.What You'll DoLong-Form & Podcast EditingEdit full-length video podcasts, interviews, original shows, and digital series for YouTube and other platforms. Edit multi-camera productions and seamlessly switch between angles based on conversation, reactions, and story. Sync and edit multiple camera and audio sources. Edit and prepare audio versions of podcast episodes for Spotify, Apple Podcasts, and other podcast platforms. Perform color correction, dialogue cleanup, audio balancing, and basic sound design. Add intros/outros, lower thirds, graphics, captions, music, B-roll, and branded elements. Create engaging openings and maintain strong pacing throughout longer episodes. Short-Form & Promotional EditingTurn long-form episodes into compelling Reels, TikToks, and YouTube Shorts. Identify moments with strong hooks, reactions, humor, controversy, insight, or emotional impact. Create trailers, teasers, cold opens, episode promos, and highlight packages. Reframe and optimize content for vertical and horizontal formats. Understand that a 60-second social edit requires different pacing and storytelling than a 45-minute YouTube episode. Post-Production WorkflowOrganize raw footage, project files, audio, graphics, and final exports. Maintain organized editing projects that another editor can easily open and understand. Complete revisions based on producer/director notes. Export content according to platform specifications. Help maintain consistent editing and visual standards across Phrkz Network programming. Manage multiple assignments while meeting production deadlines.QualificationsMust reside in Los Angeles County, California.Currently enrolled in or recently graduated from a college/university program in film, media, communications, or a related field—or equivalent experience/portfolio.Previous video editing experience is required—this is not a learn-from-zero editing internship.Portfolio, demo reel, or work samples required.Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, AVID, or comparable professional editing software.Experience editing both short-form and/or long-form content.Strong understanding of storytelling, pacing, music, sound, reactions, and visual rhythm.Comfortable working with multi-camera footage.Basic knowledge of audio editing, color correction, captions, graphics, and exporting.Able to work independently and make creative decisions without requiring detailed instructions for every cut.Strong time management and ability to work within quick turnaround deadlines.Comfortable receiving notes, making revisions, and collaborating with producers and other editors.Interest in entertainment, pop culture, podcasts, music, dance, digital media, and original programming.Internship DetailsSchedule: 8–15 hours per week with flexible scheduling to accommodate classes or other commitments.Location: Hybrid—remote editing plus occasional on-site filming in Gardena, CA.Compensation: Paid internshipAcademic credit available if approved by your institution.Other Information:Exempt/Non-Exempt: ExemptEOE Statement: We are an equal employment opportunity employer. Build a career working for an industry leader that truly invests in their people – and equips them with leading technology, continuous learning, and the ability to bring their best selves to work. As North America’s largest total beverage distributor, Southern Glazer’s isn't just one of Forbes’ Top Private Companies; it's a family-owned business with deep roots dating back to 1933.Southern Glazer’s is proud of its well-earned positive reputation, continually achieving accolades for our outstanding workplace culture. We take pride in creating a culture where our people are valued, supported, and provided opportunities for growth and belonging. By joining Southern Glazer’s, you would be part of a team that values excellence, innovation, and community. This is more than just a job – it's an opportunity to build the future of beverage distribution and grow with a company that truly cares about its people. Southern Glazer’s offers a competitive compensation package with an hourly pay rate of $25 / hour. In determining a final offer, the company will evaluate a specific candidate's education, skills and experience and will make an offer appropriately. OverviewThe Southern Glazer’s Internship Program was established to develop the next generation of Technology leaders. Each summer, the program offers interns the opportunity to engage in career building activities while simultaneously learning and applying industry-leading practices.This hands-on experience gives interns the chance to explore and understand the adult beverage industry. The knowledge gained from industry leaders will allow you to build a network of professionals within the beverage alcohol industry and here at Southern Glazer’s. Being a Southern Glazer’s intern means you’ll be invited to our Leadership Spotlight Series, a Community Service Day exclusive to our intern class, as well as access to Professional Development workshops and trainings! This role will be specifically working with the Domain team, learning and supporting the development of microservices guided by our AI platform, applying software development best practices, assisting in the creation of knowledge repository documentation using our AI platform, etc. The structured internship is designed to expose students to the wine and spirits Three-Tier beverage distribution system and the role technology plays to enable business capabilities. Interns will finish the program having gained broad experience in various aspects of the relationship between technology, sales and operations. Part of the experience will include supporting projects as assigned and defined by student’s specific learning goals, participating in training, on-site meetings, and department wide learning opportunities as available. Lastly, interns will complete an end of internship project showcasing one’s knowledge and present to management. jobs.title: Process Control Engineering Intern at Cleveland-Cliffs
jobs.description: Employer: Cleveland-Cliffs Expires: 10/24/2026 Cleveland-Cliffs takes pride in offering a variety of opportunities for students and new graduates who have an interest in the steel industry and a passion for innovation and sustainability. We offer a best-in-class internship program in the industry and partner with many universities to provide co-op opportunities. Working beside industry-leading engineering and operational leaders, our interns/co-ops will create meaningful solutions to real-world problems. As an intern/co-op with Cleveland-Cliffs, you will build life-long professional connections and have the opportunity to be considered for future full-time employment. As a Process Control Engineering Intern at Cleveland-Cliffs, the projects assigned will vary based on the intern’s education level and plant location, but will generally reflect the duties outlined below. Summary of Responsibilities:Software development in a variety of programming languages and on a variety of hardware platformsMaintenance of computer hardware and softwareMaintenance and problem solving of all aspects of the automation systemModifications to the automation system to adapt to new products and processesAddress issues that may impact production or system reliabilityProcess modeling for mill processes of a chemical, metallurgical and mechanical natureAdministration of a variety of Operating Systems and relational databases on workstations and serversWork with complex measurement systems, such as:Vision systems for product qualityThermal imaging temperature measurementsRFID and barcode tag reading for product identificationX-ray, nuclear gauges, and other gauging systemsWork with networking technologies, high-speed data transmission, and specialty interfacesClose coordination with a production departmentRespond to routine and emergency requestsManage local area project, task, and priority listsMake recommendations for system and process improvementsWork with vendors on products and performance issuesCoordinating with Research and Development and other staff departmentsMinimum Qualifications:Enrollment in Bachelor of Science program in the field of Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or other related technical degreeCompletion of sophomore year of study by the summer of 2027Applicants for this position must be currently legally authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Cleveland-Cliffs is a leading North America-based steel producer with focus on value-added sheet products, particularly for the automotive industry. The Company is vertically integrated from the mining of iron ore, production of pellets and direct reduced iron, and processing of ferrous scrap through primary steelmaking and downstream finishing, stamping, tooling, and tubing. We offer an excellent total compensation package, including competitive pay with variable compensation opportunity, health insurance, retirement plan, education assistance, paid time off, and more. Cleveland-Cliffs Inc. is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please send an e-mail to careers@clevelandcliffs.com or call 1-(312) 899-3097 and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. Do not email your application materials to this email address. Application materials sent to this email address will not be considered. Cleveland-Cliffs Inc. is an equal opportunity employer – M/F/Veteran/Disability. We are a drug-free workplace and conduct pre-employment screening as a condition of employment.

jobs.title: Industrial Engineering Intern, Summer 2027 at BAE Systems, Inc.
jobs.description: Employer: BAE Systems, Inc. - Space & Mission Systems Expires: 10/24/2026 In this position, you will participate in BAE Systems' nationwide LEAP Internship & Co-op Program, where you will Learn, Engage, Apply, and Progress within the company. The LEAP Program will provide you with the opportunity to work alongside experienced professionals on impactful projects, engage in career development opportunities, and network with our business leaders and the other students in the program.At the BAE Systems Space & Mission Systems (SMS) Westminster Colorado location, we develop and manufacture state of the art RF & sensor technologies that are integrated onto tactical missile and aircraft platforms. If you’d like to join our rapidly growing operations team in a mission to help the warfighter, this could be an ideal role for you.This is an incredible opportunity for a student, preferably with an Industrial Engineering degree focused on Manufacturing and Systems, to support the production of advanced RF products. Additionally, this role serves as the jumping off point to other exciting career opportunities at BAE Systems which includes Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Operations, Operations Management, or Value Stream Manger just to name a few!This is a challenging and dynamic role responsible for manufacturing planning and production, material availability, material and product flow, capacity and bottleneck resolution, as well as improvement efforts that drive our operational strategy. This opportunity requires a result driven individual with solid organizational skills, ability to thrive in a team environment, and a passion for continuous improvement.The Operations Strategic Capabilities Unit plays a fundamental role in enabling efficient business and program execution – from strategic capital investments, industrial operations and an efficient supply chain, to state-of-the-art manufacturing and test operations and top-notch facilities management.What You’ll Do: Practice Lean Manufacturing principals and methodologies.Effectively work in a cross-functional team environment.Develop and implement systems and improvement strategies for direct material flow (in plant transport, inventory staging/access, and assembly line supply) including capacity and bottleneck resolution.Evaluate process improvements for operations (labor balancing, time studies, picking, kitting, packing and loading, line-side storage setup, and product sequencing) to minimize downtime and rework.Coordinate equipment / process changes related to materials picking, packaging, storage, transport, delivery, line-side use, returns, and any other material related issues to support all assembly lines.Perform various analysis of the value stream ensuring proper layouts, material flows, and available capacity enabling successful program execution.Maintain an intense focus and continuous presence where the work is performed. Take daily Gemba walks, go and see to gather the facts, and develop a deep and thorough understanding of the process.Be accountable, drive accountability within the organization, and put problems first with a sense of urgency.Maintain a regular and predictable work schedule.Establish and maintain effective working relationships within the department, the Strategic Business Units, Strategic Capabilities Units and the Company. Interact appropriately with others in order to maintain a positive and productive work environment.Perform other duties as necessary.On-Site Work Environment: This position requires regular in-person engagement by working on-site five days each normally scheduled week in the primary work location. Travel and local commute between company campuses and other possible non-company locations may be required.Working Conditions: Work is performed in an office environment, laboratory, cleanroom, or production floor.Hourly Rate: $26.50 - $35.75Required Education, Experience, & Skills Must have completed your sophomore or junior year and be enrolled in a degree program for the fall of 2027. We will also accept students enrolled in a graduate degree program.Degree must be from a university, college, or school which is accredited by an agency recognized by the US Secretary of Education, US Department of Education.Field of study in industrial engineering, systems engineering, manufacturing engineering, or similar.Effective communication skills.Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to work with cross-functional teams using effective communication.Excellent demonstrated organizational skills and a focus on timely delivery of specified deliverables’ goals and objectives.Demonstrated intellectual curiosity, ability, and willingness to multitask and prioritize projects given multiple opportunities.A creative approach to problem solving and an appetite for experimentation.A problem-solving endurance that persists in the wake of initial setbacks.Pay InformationFull-Time Salary Range: $49592 - $68993Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.Temporary employees generally are not eligible for BAE Systems benefits, but can elect to participate in the 401(k) savings plan. Temporary employees working 20+ hours per week are eligible for medical benefits, the employee assistance program, and business travel accident insurance.About BAE Systems, Inc.BAE Systems, Inc. is a defense, aerospace, and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, with more than 40,000 employees worldwide. We serve, supply, and protect those who protect us. As one of the most geographically diverse international defense companies, we deliver a full range of products and services spanning air, land, maritime, space, and cyber, including advanced electronics, intelligence solutions, and dedicated customer support.Our culture is performance-driven and values-led, built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. Purpose isn't a tagline here. It's what drives us. We're developing breakthrough technologies that defend national security and make a lasting impact on our communities and our planet. When you join BAE Systems, you're not just building a career. You're contributing to a mission that truly matters.This position will be posted for at least 5 calendar days. The posting will remain active until the position is filled, or a qualified pool of candidates is identified.

jobs.description: Employer: Celestica Expires: 10/25/2026 3 Month InternshipAs a global technology leader, Celestica designs, engineers, and manufactures industry-leading products and services that drive customer success and market advancement. Headquartered in Toronto, Canada, we bring together over 33,000 employees across more than 45 sites in North America, Europe, and Asia. With deep expertise in design, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain management and platform solutions, Celestica enables critical data center infrastructure for AI, cloud, and hybrid cloud and advances technologies in high-growth markets. Working with the world’s leading technology companies across a broad range of industries, Celestica helps its customers achieve a competitive advantage. These products span key areas such as data centre technology, aerospace and defense, healthtech, and capital equipment. Working at Celestica is more than a job. It’s about being part of something bigger and shaping the future with your work. You’ll take on exciting and challenging projects, get hands-on experience, collaborate with a global team, and learn from some of the greatest minds in the industry. And just as we aspire to imagine, develop and deliver a better future with our customers, we’re just as committed to delivering the best employee experience. Benefits for Students Include:Experience working for one of the largest Canadian global technology companiesPossibility of a student casual contract position after completion of internship Possibility of a full-time position after completion of degree Access to Celestica’s development programs and projectsCelestica's Time Off to Volunteer program – two paid days off to volunteer per yearFun intern activities including celebration events and networkingInternal recognition programs and rewards for stellar performanceWhat’s in it for you?Opportunity: Job experience at a large Canadian-based global companyInnovation: We look to our employees to implement new ideas and improve the way we do thingsCollaboration: Students work as part of global teams, enabled by collaborative technologySustainability: We uphold strong ethics, reduce our impact on the environment and empower employees to give back to the community with two paid days off per year to volunteerDevelopment opportunities: including soft skills courses, innovation projects and mentorshipNetworking: Strategically build your professional network to advance your career and deepen relationships across your peers and colleagues. Fun: Our interns have the opportunity to participate in fun activities including intern social events, Celestica’s charitable initiatives and our Spirit Week activities About this opportunity:The Signal Integrity Engineering Intern will gain hands-on experience by supporting the planning, simulation, lab verification, and troubleshooting of digital PCB designs. In this role, you will assist in critical design reviews for signal integrity and work closely with global, cross-functional teams, including manufacturing, industrial design, and project leadership. You will work alongside experienced engineers to research system ideas, support schematic capture, and validate electrical systems, contributing to robust and high-quality product development from the early design phases through manufacturing support.Preferred Skills: Foundational knowledge of signal integrity, power integrity, and high-speed digital PCB design principles.Familiarity with or a strong desire to learn industry-standard SI/PI simulation software including:SI Tools: Keysight ADS, ANSYS toolsuite (HFSS, SIWave, Designer), Synopsys Hspice, Siemens HyperLynx, Polar Si8000, or Cadence/Sigrity System SI.PI Tools: Cadence Sigrity Power SI, Power DC, Optimize PI.Basic understanding of or coursework involving high-frequency lab measurement equipment, such as:Keysight, Tektronix, or LeCroy real-time and sampling oscilloscopes.Vector Network Analyzers (VNA) and Time Domain Reflectometers (TDR).Introductory knowledge of high-speed compliance standards (e.g., PCIe Gen5/Gen6, Ethernet, USB 3.0, SAS/SATA).Experience with numerical computing environments like MATLAB.Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively within team structures.Activities:Design Support: Assist in the development of electrical systems, contributing to system architectures, schematics, and Bill of Materials (BOMs).Simulation & Analysis: Perform signal integrity (SI) and power integrity (PI) simulations to help evaluate design trade-offs based on performance and manufacturability.Lab Verification: Support the validation and characterization of systems by assisting with lab testing of high-speed digital interfaces and correlating simulation data with physical measurement results.Compliance Testing: Help execute physical layer compliance testing to ensure circuit designs meet industry standards.Cross-Functional Collaboration: Participate in design reviews to incorporate feedback regarding testing, supply chain, and reliability while working with internal stakeholders and vendors.Documentation: Develop and maintain technical documentation, including test reports, analysis summaries, and project updates to support engineering decisions.Physical DemandsDuties of this position are performed in a normal office environment.Duties may require extended periods of sitting and sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data.Repetitive manual movements (e.g., data entry, using a computer mouse, using a calculator, etc.) are frequently required.SalaryThe range described in this posting is an estimate by the Company, and may change based on several factors, including but not limited to a change in the duties covered by the job posting, or the credentials, experience or geographic jurisdiction of the successful candidate. The hourly wage is determined by the years of study completed and is non-negotiable as per company policy. Hourly Wage: $24-30 USD/hr Area: Engineering Start Date: May/June 2027 Location: Silicon Valley Vacancies: 1 Experience: No Formal Experience Required Education: Pursuing a Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field, in their third year of study. To apply, please visit www.celestica.com. Please provide a copy of your transcript with your application. Please include your student email address in your application. Celestica is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, pregnancy, genetic information, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected category under applicable federal, state, and local laws. This policy applies to hiring, promotion, discharge, pay, fringe benefits, job training, classification, referral and other aspects of employment and also states that retaliation against a person who files a charge of discrimination, participates in a discrimination proceeding, or otherwise opposes an unlawful employment practice will not be tolerated. All information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.Celestica is an E-Verify employer. COMPANY OVERVIEW: Celestica, Inc. (NYSE: CLS; TSX: CLS) is a technology leader dedicated to driving customer success and market advancements. With deep expertise in design, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and platform solutions, Celestica enables critical data center infrastructure for AI, cloud, and hybrid cloud and advances technologies in high-growth markets. jobs.description: Employer: Cato Institute Expires: 10/25/2026 To be considered for this role, you must apply directly through our online application. OverviewCato's Audio/Visual team operates a broadcast-ready production facility — including a professional auditorium with robotic camera systems, LED displays, and a full control room — that produces live events, long-form documentaries and policy featurettes, podcast recordings, and short-form digital content. Interns are active members of the production team with responsibilities during live events. Each intern manages one full production per term, which includes planning, directing, filming, editing, and delivering an original video about Cato's internship program for marketing and donor communications. Past interns have also contributed to documentary projects, long-form policy featurettes, live broadcasts, podcast editing, and short videos for Cato's digital platforms. The work is practical and fast-paced, perfect for applicants with real production experience who are prepared to independently manage a project from start to finish.ResponsibilitiesPlan, direct, shoot, and edit an original video each term documenting Cato's internship program — a fully intern-led production delivered for marketing and donor-facing use, from concept through final delivery.Contribute to creating original video content — including documentaries, policy featurettes, and short-form digital pieces — throughout development, filming, and post-production.Operate cameras, audio gear, and studio lighting in both studio and field environments.Assist with live studio productions, including operating the production switcher and supporting broadcast workflows in Cato's auditorium.Edit video and audio content with Adobe Premiere Pro, including long-form and short-form deliverables.Log, archive, and update b-roll footage; manage and enhance the team's archive library.Pitch and develop original content ideas in collaboration with the production team.Assist with cross-team content projects as assigned, including short-form videos for Cato's digital platforms.Required QualificationsDemonstrated interest in using video and audio production to communicate ideas to broad audiences; aligns with Cato's principles of individual liberty, limited government, free markets, and peace.Prior on-set production experience with proven ability to work independently in various production roles — whether through a film program, production company, campus media outlet, or freelance work. Applicants who have only assisted on set should consider if they are ready to lead a complete production independently.Working knowledge of camera operation, audio recording, and basic studio and field lighting.Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro or similar non-linear editing softwareReliable and composed under tight deadlines and fast-paced workflows.Collaborative, receptive to direction and feedback, and able to communicate clearly with producers and on-camera talent.Professionalism, reliability, and attention to detail — production work demands technical precision, consistent follow-through, and professional conduct on set.Preferred QualificationsExperience in live broadcast production, including operating production switchers or managing multi-camera workflows.Knowledge of studio lighting arrangements and broadcast camera equipment.Experience directing or producing documentary or long-form nonfiction content.FAA drone pilot certification or experience in aerial cinematography.A production portfolio showcasing versatility across formats — studio, field, short-form, and long-form.Finalists will be asked to share a production portfolio or video editing sample.The Cato Internship ProgramCato’s paid internships are available for undergraduates, recent graduates, graduate students, law students, and early-career professionals who are strongly committed to individual liberty, limited government, free markets, and peace—principles that together form libertarianism, also known as “classical liberalism,” “market liberalism,” or, to many of our international friends, simply “liberalism.” All Cato interns participate in the same intensive seminar series, which covers a wide range of topics in history, philosophy, policy, and professional development. Interns also assist with events and occasionally support Cato staff with other daily tasks. Interns receive competitive pay. Part-time roles are adjusted accordingly and require a minimum of 25 hours per week. Program participants must be able to attend in person in Washington, D.C. For more information about the internship program and experience, we encourage you to explore our website. If you have any questions, email studentprograms@cato.org.
